validation: The validated gemma4 recipe on abliterated weights, now sourced from coder3101/gemma-4-31B-it-heretic @ revision 9a1c7f5d851541f279cd104329e093cb363cd9e7 (uncensored/heretic lineage, base google/gemma-4-31B-it): 2 safetensors shards totalling 58.3 GiB bf16 (49.92 + 12.62 GiB) — same footprint and architecture as google/gemma-4-31B-it (config diff vs the twin: only moe_intermediate_size:null; Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration, 60 text layers, 16 KV heads, head_dim 256, 1024-token sliding window on 5/6 layers), so the same TP1 sizing applies on one 268 GiB B300: full-attention worst case ~0.94 MiB/token, max-model-len capped at 32768 (~30 GiB KV upper bound, far less with the sliding window). SWITCHED 2026-10-29: the previous source wangzhang/gemma-4-31B-it-abliterated ships NEITHER processor_config.json NOR preprocessor_config.json (the google twin has only the former); vLLM 0.32's gemma4_mm builds the HF processor at EngineCore (dummy encoder profiling) and died with OSError 'Can't load feature extractor ... containing a preprocessor_config.json' after the weights loaded. Reproduced locally with transformers 5.22 (same OSError on the wangzhang file set; the coder3101 file set loads Gemma4ImageProcessor + Gemma4AudioFeatureExtractor cleanly — its preprocessor_config.json is byte-identical to the google twin's inline image_processor block, Gemma4ImageProcessor patch 16 / 280 soft tokens). chat_template.jinja uses plain truthy 'tools' (no 'is not none' guard, so no deephat-style template crash). Parser candidates gemma4/gemma4 are resolved from the image's registry before the cold load and --enable-auto-tool-choice is appended by the launcher (the gemma4 lesson). Known upstream caveats are the twin's: tool-call format bugs (vllm #39468) and <pad> tokens under concurrent tool calls (#39392); four_concurrent_requests + forced_function_call surface either. NOT yet GPU-validated (the google twin passed the chat suite); trust it only after a first READY endpoint and its chat_tools checks.
